sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Amelie.
In this podcast, we speak very slowly. We use easy English. We repeat words many times.
Today we travel to Africa. We go to Egypt. Our city today is Aswan. Aswan is calm. Aswan is warm.
Aswan is full of history and nature. Please relax. Please listen slowly. Let's begin our journey.
Part two, Egypt and Africa. Egypt is a country in North Africa. It is one of the oldest countries in the world.
Egypt has deserts. Egypt has temples. Egypt has the Nile River. Many people know Cairo. Many people know the pyramids.
But today we talk about Aswan. Aswan is quieter. Aswan is very special.
Part three, where is Aswan? Aswan is in the south of Egypt. It is near the border with Sudan.
The city is next to the Nile River. The Nile is very important. Life in Aswan depends on the river.
The river gives water. The river gives life. Aswan feels close to nature.
Part four, weather and climate. Aswan is very hot. The sun is strong. It rains very little. The air is dry.
In summer, days are long and hot. In winter, days are warm. People wear light clothes.
Life moves slowly because of the heat. The climate shapes daily life.
Part five, a city with ancient history. Aswan has a very long history. People lived here thousands of years ago.
The city was important in ancient Egypt. It was a trade center. Stones for temples came from Aswan.
History is in the ground. History is in the stones. The past is everywhere.
Part six, the Nile River. The Nile River is the heart of Aswan. People see the river every day.
They work near the river. They rest near the river. Small boats move slowly.
The water looks calm and blue. The river brings peace. The river brings life.
Not part seven, Nubian culture. Aswan is home to Nubian people. They have a strong culture.
Nubian houses are colorful. Music is important. Family is important.
People welcome visitors with smiles. Life feels warm and human. Culture is alive in Aswan.
Part eight temples and monuments near Aswan. There are many temples. One famous place is Philae Temple.
It is on an island. Another famous place is Abu symbol. It has huge statues.
People visit these places quietly. They feel history and power. These monuments tell old stories.
Part nine, daily life in Aswan. Daily life in Aswan is slow. People wake up early.
They work in the morning. They rest in the afternoon. In the evening people meet.
They drink tea. They talk and relax. Life is simple. Life is peaceful.
Part ten, food in Aswan. Food in Aswan is simple and healthy. People eat rice, bread and vegetables.
Fish from the Nile is popular. Food is fresh. Meals are shared with family. People eat together.
Food is part of community life. Part eleven, nature and islands. Aswan has many small islands.
They are green and calm. Palm trees grow near the river. Birds fly in the sky.
People visit islands by boat. Nature feels close and gentle. Aswan is quiet and beautiful.
Part twelve, feeling, spirit and goodbye. Aswan is a city of the Nile.
Ancient history, warm people and slow life. It is not loud. It is not fast. It is peaceful.
